item.title: Medium‐Concentration Electrolytes Balance Hydrogen‐Bond Disruption and Ion–Ion Interactions for Wide‐Temperature Aqueous Trivalent Indium Metal Batteries
item.description:

Advanced Energy Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work shows medium-concentration chloride electrolytes, not maximum concentration, optimally balance hydrogen-bond disruption and ion–ion interactions. The 1 m InCl₃ + 10 m LiCl electrolyte enables wide-temperature aqueous trivalent indium batteries (−70 to +65 °C) with high Coulombic efficiency (99–99.95%), suppressing freezing and water-induced side reactions. It establishes solvation-structure tuning as key to wide-temperature aqueous trivalent electrolytes.
🏷 aqueous battery · indium metal anode · medium-concentration electrolyte · wide-temperature · solvation structure

Advanced Energy Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The study introduces a Janus Ag nanoskin-armored polyimide bilayer separator that regulates lithium nucleation via a lithiophilic 3D host, suppressing dendrite growth. It achieves high Coulombic efficiency (98.9%), Li⁺ transference number (0.70), and 1600 h cycling stability. This universal strategy enables dendrite-free lithium metal batteries with improved safety and performance.

💡 Trace SbF3 doping in P/C anodes forms an in situ Li3Sb-LiF hybrid interphase during lithiation, simultaneously suppressing polyphosphide shuttling and combining fast ion/electron transport with mechanical rigidity. This resolves the stability-transport trade-off, delivering 970 mAh g⁻¹ after 500 cycles and 893 mAh g⁻¹ at 15 A g⁻¹, with practical pouch-cell validation.

💡 This review uniquely positions aluminum fuel cells as recyclable energy carriers, integrating material development, electrolyte lifecycle management, and closed-loop Al(OH)₃-to-Al regeneration using renewable electricity. Its significance lies in benchmarking against practical targets (≥99% anode utilization, ≥2000 h cathode life, ≥500 Wh kg⁻¹) and comparing system-level performance with hydrogen fuel cells and diesel generators, advancing sustainable long-duration energy storage.
